title: Holiness in Daily Life

questions.question: What is the central reason given for Israelites to be holy?
options: For I the Lord your God am holy
questions.correctAnswer: For I the Lord your God am holy
questions.explanation: Leviticus 19:2 (ESV): "You shall be holy, for I the Lord your God am holy."

questions.question: Who should every person revere?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 19:3 (ESV): "Every one of you shall revere his mother and his father."

questions.question: What should be left for the poor and the sojourner during harvest?
options: The gleanings and the edges of the field
questions.correctAnswer: The gleanings and the edges of the field
questions.explanation: Leviticus 19:9-10 (ESV): "You shall not reap your field right up to its edge... You shall leave them for the poor and for the sojourner."

questions.question: You shall not steal; nor deal...?
options: Falsely; nor lie to one another
questions.correctAnswer: Falsely; nor lie to one another
questions.explanation: Leviticus 19:11 (ESV): "You shall not steal; you shall not deal falsely; you shall not lie to one another."

questions.question: How should you judge your neighbor?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 19:15 (ESV): "In righteousness you shall judge your neighbor."

questions.question: You shall not take vengeance or bear a grudge, but you shall...?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 19:18 (ESV): "You shall love your neighbor as yourself: I am the Lord."

questions.question: What mixtures were forbidden (cattle, seed, garment)?
options: Breeding different kinds, sowing two kinds of seed, wearing two kinds of material
questions.correctAnswer: Breeding different kinds, sowing two kinds of seed, wearing two kinds of material
questions.explanation: Leviticus 19:19 (ESV): "You shall not let your cattle breed with a different kind... sow... two kinds of seed... nor garment of cloth made of two kinds of material."

questions.question: What should you do before the gray head (elderly)?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 19:32 (ESV): "You shall stand up before the gray head and honor the face of an old man."

questions.question: How should a stranger (sojourner) be treated?
options: As a native, love him as yourself
questions.correctAnswer: As a native, love him as yourself
questions.explanation: Leviticus 19:34 (ESV): "The stranger... shall be to you as the native among you, and you shall love him as yourself."

questions.question: You shall do no injustice in court or in measurement of...?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 19:35 (ESV): "You shall do no wrong in judgment, in measures of length or weight or quantity."

questions.question: When you plant trees for food, how long is their fruit forbidden?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 19:23 (ESV): "Three years it shall be forbidden to you; it must not be eaten."

questions.question: What happens in the fourth year to the fruit of the tree?
options: It is holy, an offering of praise to the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: It is holy, an offering of praise to the Lord
questions.explanation: Leviticus 19:24 (ESV): "And in the fourth year all its fruit shall be holy, an offering of praise to the Lord."

questions.question: You shall not round off the hair on your temples or mar...? (forbidden mourning practice)
questions.explanation: Leviticus 19:27 (ESV): "You shall not round off the hair on your temples or mar the edges of your beard."

questions.question: Do not turn to mediums or necromancers; why?
options: So as to make yourselves unclean by them
questions.correctAnswer: So as to make yourselves unclean by them
questions.explanation: Leviticus 19:31 (ESV): "Do not turn to mediums or necromancers; do not seek them out, and so make yourselves unclean by them."

questions.question: You shall not curve (tattoo) marks on yourselves for...?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 19:28 (ESV): "You shall not make any cuts on your body for the dead or tattoo yourselves."

key_verse_text: You shall not take vengeance or bear a grudge against the sons of your own people, but you shall love your neighbor as yourself: I am the Lord.
